title: Speech and Language Processing
subtitle: An Introduction to Natural Language Processing, Computational Linguistics, and Speech Recognition (3rd ed. draft)
author: Daniel Jurafsky, James H. Martin
description: The standard graduate textbook on NLP and computational linguistics: language models, part-of-speech tagging, parsing, information extraction, semantics, and speech recognition. The freely available 3rd edition draft is continuously updated.
